import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int maxn = 6010;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int n, m, k, c, d, cnt, total_cost;
    static int[] a = new int[maxn], x = new int[maxn], y = new int[maxn];
    static int[] head = new int[maxn], pre = new int[maxn], dist = new int[maxn], inq = new int[maxn];
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int S, T;

    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, cost, nxt;
        public Edge(int to, int cap, int cost, int nxt) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.nxt = nxt;
        }
    }

    static int node_id(int t, int v) {
        return t * n + v;
    }

    static void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        edges.add(new Edge(to, cap, cost, head[from]));
        head[from] = edges.size() - 1;
        edges.add(new Edge(from, 0, -cost, head[to]));
        head[to] = edges.size() - 1;
    }

    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inq, 0);
        q.clear();
        dist[s] = 0;
        q.offer(s);
        inq[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            inq[v] = 0;
            for (int i = head[v]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).nxt) {
                int u = edges.get(i).to;
                if (edges.get(i).cap > 0 && dist[u] > dist[v] + edges.get(i).cost) {
                    dist[u] = dist[v] + edges.get(i).cost;
                    pre[u] = i;
                    if (inq[u] == 0) {
                        q.offer(u);
                        inq[u] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] < INF;
    }

    static void update_flow(int s, int t) {
        for (int i = t; i != s; i = edges.get(pre[i] ^ 1).to) {
            edges.get(pre[i]).cap--;
            edges.get(pre[i] ^ 1).cap++;
        }
        total_cost += dist[t];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        S = 0;
        T = 6000;

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
            add_edge(S, node_id(0, a[i]), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            x[i] = sc.nextInt();
            y[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= 100; t++) {
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                add_edge(node_id(t, i), node_id(t + 1, i), k, c);
            }
            add_edge(node_id(t, 1), T, k, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= Math.min(k, 25); j++) {
                    add_edge(node_id(t, x[i]), node_id(t + 1, y[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
                    add_edge(node_id(t, y[i]), node_id(t + 1, x[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }

        while (spfa(S, T)) {
            update_flow(S, T);
        }

        System.out.println(total_cost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
